name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This makes the ring visible on all backgrounds while keeping it compact. Trade-off: the ring is slightly thicker than minimal specs, but it’s the safest choice for low-vision users without cluttering the UI.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring could vanish—like a dark page with a busy texture. A 3px solid ring in #005fcc meets WCAG 2.1 AA at 4.5:1 and avoids the inner-ring trap. Test it on a zebra-striped background to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring (total 5px) for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on all backgrounds, including high-contrast patterns, without relying on inner rings that can disappear. Trade-off: the ring is slightly thinner than the 4px version, but it’s the only choice that guarantees visibility for low-vision users across all backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: A 3px solid ring with a 1px white inner ring still risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring can blur or vanish against busy textures. A better alternative is a 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px #ffffff outer ring—this ensures the focus indicator remains visible on all backgrounds while meeting WCAG 2.1 AA. Test it on a zebra-striped background and measure contrast ratios to settle it.
